Senior Year Edition · 2026–27

Badger Campus Cards

This is my last year at UW–Madison, so I turned the places that mattered most into a collectible card set. Each card has a photo, some very scientific stats, and a favorite memory on the back. The idea comes from Georges Perec, who wrote about ordinary places with the kind of attention most people save for big events.

Tap a card to flip it and read the memory.

Card 1 of 8 drawn

Every card comes up once before the deck reshuffles.
